text.description_html:
Don-Jo KP-8x40-1/4-BT, 8x40-1/4 Brass Tone Aluminum Kickplate

The 8x40-1/4 Brass Tone Aluminum Kickplate is made of .040 inch thick aluminum. Packaged with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation. This Brass Tone Aluminum 8 inch x 40-1/4 inch Kickplate is primarily used in restaurants, warehouses, factories, and stores.

Specifications of the 8 x 40-1/4 Brass Tone Aluminum Kickplate:

  • Material: Aluminum
  • Finish: Brass Tone
  • Plate Height: 8"
  • Plate Width: 40-1/4"
  • Plate Thickness: .040" (1.2 mm)
  • Packaged With Mounting Screws

Sold Individually
